name: Begues (Spain)
description: Vertical bicolour of white and red, charged at the centre with the light green eradicated tree of the arms between two black ring-shaped frames.
history: The council opened the adoption file on 3 October 2012; the flag was approved on 23 December 2016 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 7286 of 13 January 2017. It is based on the municipal arms, with the light green tree and the two black frames on a white and red bicolour ground.

features.role: light green eradicated tree, 11/14 of the height
two ring-shaped frames of the arms
